messages:
ops-alert-bot: ALERT: 502 spike (hosted-inference) in aus-syd1 edge backhaul. rate 8.2% over 5m. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/2712345678
support-liz: Customer AcmeCorp reporting repeated 502s and timeouts since 03:14 UTC. They see auth retries and occasional billing validation failures.
customer-success-anna: their ticket #ACME-452 — they say errors surface after warmup, mostly on larger batch requests (~100-500 tokens). provided sample request ids.
sre-tilly: I can confirm elevated packet loss on syd1 backhaul to our regional proxies around 03:12-03:18 UTC. pulling pcap and flow logs now.
eng-josh: sharing a quick check: I'm seeing connect timeouts from edge -> regional-proxy 10.4.3.22 and TCP retransmit spike. logs: `tcp_retrans=high` on the proxy.
neteng-raj: provider (ASN 64001) reported a BGP flap during that window, we saw a path change to a secondary carrier that introduced asymmetric routing and reorder. provider ticket PRV-7821 opened.
support-liz: repro steps from customer: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":400}'` -> ~30% 502s when batch size >200 tokens. smaller batches look fine.
sre-tilly: mitigation applied at 03:26 UTC: adjusted routing policy to prefer alternate carrier path with lower packet loss. started canary fallback to rwd-lite-1 for impacted zone. error-rate dropping.
ops-alert-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback executed for routes with >5% 5xx — model fallback and route preference logged.
oncall-marc: no config rollback. keeping alternate route pinned until provider confirms repair. will monitor for 60m.
eng-josh: added quick guidance to support KB: recommend exponential backoff + jitter and advise smaller batch sizes during regional instability. snippet: `retry: { attempts: 3, base_ms: 200, jitter: true }`.
customer-success-anna: emailed AcmeCorp with repro acknowledgement, mitigation steps, and proposed follow-up call. they asked about SLA credit — forwarding to finance ops.
neteng-raj: provider ETA for fiber repair / stabilization: 04:15 UTC. they flagged root cause as faulty fiber splice causing microbursts.
sre-tilly: monitoring shows stable error rate <0.5% at 03:55 UTC. filing postmortem action items: 1) better AS-path health alerts, 2) automated quick-failover to secondary carrier, 3) add packet-reorder detection to edge metrics.
support-liz: marking incident as resolved from CS side, scheduling customer call tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
